system.description:
A snorted white powder favoured by executives and thugs alike, Alpha floods the body with threat pheromones and a sense of dominance, leaving users brash and forgetful of anything learned while high.

The user can go several days without any sleep. For one scene they also roll +1k1 on offensive social combat rolls and +1k1 on rolls to resist fear.
system.effectText: No sleep needed for days; +1k1 offensive social combat and +1k1 vs fear for one scene.
